name: @caisson/license-issue
description: Ed25519 offline-license issuer: the private counterpart to @caisson/license-verify. Holds the signing key behind a Signer port (default Ed25519Signer over a node:crypto PKCS8 env key; KMS is an un-wired seam) and mints signed license tokens by signing exactly canonicalize(parse(claims)) - the byte-identical payload @caisson/license-verify re-derives. Never published; the signing code lives only with the issuer service.
